name: Camera Preview
author: Mandavkar Pranjal
description: Live camera preview popup with device picker and snapshot capture

barWidget.description: Click the camera icon to open a live preview of the selected camera

schema.label: Camera device
schema.description: Device id from the picker inside the panel, or "auto" for the system default camera.

schema.label: Preview width
schema.description: Width of the live preview in the popup; height follows a 16:9 ratio.

schema.label: Mirror preview
schema.description: Flip the preview horizontally, like a mirror. Snapshots are always saved unmirrored.
